title: Narghe Mai Ab Hai Muslim e Nashaad ya Hussain
body:
Narghe mai ab hai muslim e nashaad ya Hussain.
Faryaad ya Hussain.
Faryaad ya Hussain.
Bekas pe bewatan pe hai uftaad ya Hussain.....
1.Khat likh ke koofiyon ne bulaya ghareeb ko.
Waade se phir ke karte hain bedaad ya Hussain.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Chakra raha hai dhoop may zakhmon se choor hai.
Waqt e madad hai kijiye imdad ya hussai....
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Muslim shaheed hogaye bejurm o beqataa.
Shayhere Madina hogaya barbaad ya Hussain.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Chhat se zameen pe lashaye muslim ko phainkkar.
Galiyon may lekay phirte hain jallad ya Hussain.
Azz:-Mazhar abedi
